title: PIGEONMAN: THE HOUSE
description: A first-person survival-horror escape game. Search a decaying house for tools, hide from a relentless pigeon predator, and choose one of two ways out.

defaultCaptions.x: Will you get out before Pigeonman finds you? PIGEONMAN: THE HOUSE is a tense first-person horror escape.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Explore the house, hide from Pigeonman, solve its puzzles and escape through one of two routes in PIGEONMAN: THE HOUSE.
defaultCaptions.reddit: I made a first-person horror escape game about a relentless pigeon monster and an abandoned house: PIGEONMAN: THE HOUSE.
defaultCaptions.discord: PIGEONMAN: THE HOUSE — find the tools, stay quiet, and escape before he catches you.
